metadata.title: Clicked like a madman, somehow triple tapped enemies like I hacked the game
metadata.description:
Me: pure panic mode
Enemies: probably uninstalling mid-air
Valorant: handing out 3 kills like it’s a glitch in the matrix
You ever get kills you swear you didn’t deserve? Same here.

Tap if your chaos clicks ever surprise even you!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykills #funnygaming #shorts
